The following events took place in '''52 BBY'''.

==Events==
*[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], at age 30, was elected to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as [[Senator/Legends|representative]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Chommell sector/Legends|sector]], replacing [[Vidar Kim]]. (ReSynchronization date '''17BrS:10:05''')<ref name="DP Novel" />
*[[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] began [[Jedi training/Legends|teaching]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
*The [[Republic Correctional Authority/Legends|Republic Correctional Authority]] was formed, and established [[Prison/Legends|prisons]] on several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] including the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]].<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>
*[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] became [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Jaster Mereel]] at the [[Battle of Korda Six]].<ref name="Open Seasons 2" />
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sought for a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] solution to the [[Sevarcos Dispute]].<ref name="Hnn-Palpatine to Separatists: Let's Talk">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_1.html|Palpatine to Separatists: Let's Talk}}</ref>

==Battles==
*[[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle]].<ref name="DP Novel" />
*[[Massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy]].<ref name="DP Novel" />
*The [[Summertime War]] began between the [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] and the [[Balawai]] on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].
*[[Battle of Korda Six]]<ref name="Open Seasons 2" />
